ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Data Exfiltration Via Audio File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential exfiltration attempt via audio file using PowerShell Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[System\\\.Math\\]\\:\\:.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\[IO\\\.FileMode\\]\\:\\:.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*BinaryWriter.*")) AND ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*0x52.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*0x49.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*0x46.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*0x57.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*0x41.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*0x56.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*0x45.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*0xAC.*")))
